items.text: Patriots will likely activate AJ Brown off IR to play vs Jets Sunday after limited practice all week on high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Practiced limited all week; sources say activate and play.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 upside if active; start him.
items.opportunity: High target share in NE offense vs Jets.

items.text: Jalen Hurts OUT for Week 6 with blood clot in calf; Eagles not planning IR placement indefinitely as info gathering continues. First game without him; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Blood clot confirmed; ruled out vs CAR.
items.implication: McKee at QB with top pass-catchers healthy but thin RB room.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume (DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks) with McKee; limited goal-line for RBs.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 6 with hamstring injury alongside Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley.
items.why: Missed all practice week with hamstring; officially ruled out vs CAR.
items.implication: Eagles RB room thin; Dameon Pierce and others in line for work behind Tanner McKee.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for backups like Dameon Pierce in PHI backfield.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT again for Week 6 with ankle injury; Ravens play another game without him.
items.why: Did not practice; ruled out vs CLE.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Flowers remains viable WR2 but Andrews downgraded.

items.text: DK Metcalf (illness) removed from injury report; no designation for Sunday vs TB. Freiermuth added as Q (calf).
items.implication: Heavy usage expected in 2-WR sets given PIT WR thinness (Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek out).
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Metcalf in limited WR corps.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Probable-leaning: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR so Metcalf heavy 2-WR. PHI McKee with top-4 pass-catchers healthy but 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce.
items.why: Practice and designation context; PIT depth issues; PHI skill talent intact.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean start probable Qs; Metcalf volume spike; McKee stack pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Metcalf routes in 2-WR; PHI WR/TE volume with McKee; Warren monitor.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 6 along with AD Mitchell.
items.why: Quad injury; DNP and ruled out.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or other backs elevated.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT for Week 6 (groin); will not travel/play vs JAX.
items.implication: Houston backfield opens for other RBs.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT for Week 6 with Tyquan Thornton.
items.implication: KC WR targets shift to Worthy/others.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed IN; cleared and expected to play with healthy top pass-catchers for McKee.
items.implication: WR2/3 with McKee; volume available sans Hurts/Saquon.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed high-ankle sprain but practiced; may be more about next Thursday availability than this week given NE schedule.
items.why: High-ankle but practiced; Graziano note on TNF next week.
items.implication: Risky start; Rhamondre elevated if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Rhamondre Stevenson full workload.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (vs WSH WR4), Drake London (vs CHI WR6), George Kittle (vs WSH TE3) for soft Commanders pass D and bankable usage.
items.why: WSH D buffet for pass catchers; London usage reliable.
items.implication: Strong WR/TE starts in favorable spots.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (vs ARI RB5), Javonte Williams (@ GB RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson (vs NYJ RB9) for volume and leaky run Ds; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line.
items.why: Volume + soft run defenses; goal-line role for Javonte.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI), J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA), Bo Nix (vs SEA), Justin Herbert (@ KC) due to tough matchups, QB issues, low totals.
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA D), shaky QB/feeding, low team totals.
items.implication: Fade or sit in most formats.
